profile.description:
Seedream 5.0 Flash creates and edits images quickly from text prompts and up to 10 reference images.

Generation & Editing
- Generate from a text prompt
- Edit or combine one to ten attached images
- Mark an area with a sketch, arrow, or coordinates to edit it precisely
- Separate one attached image into a base image plus up to 16 transparent layers
- Render text in Chinese, English, and 14 other languages

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.

**Seedream 5.0 Flash Pricing**

Billed per generated image at the same rate for every resolution. Reference images are free. Layer separation bills every returned image, the base image and each layer, at that rate.

| Mode | Rate (USD) | Rate (Points) |
|------|------------|---------------|
| Image generation | $0.030/img | 1,000 pts/img |
| Layer decomposition | $0.030/img | 1,000 pts/img |
